nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the dead ci-gated pipeline: cam-ship.md ci-gated Step 7 now instructs the orchestrator to write .claude/.cam-merge-watch.json (prNumber + mergedBranch) after gh pr create, using 'gh pr view --json number --jq .number' to capture the PR number.
